_about: One decision per workload. Set store to one of the stores listed.

pos_orders.needs: The till app in 300 shops writes each sale as it happens and updates stock levels: thousands of small concurrent transactions against normalized tables. The developers know Azure SQL Database and use SSMS.

finance_star.needs: Finance builds a star schema with T-SQL stored procedures. Each night one procedure loads FactLedger and three dimensions inside a single transaction, so a failure rolls all four back. The developers are SQL developers who never use Spark.

line_telemetry.needs: Every machine on the production line sends JSON readings several times a second. Operators run ad hoc queries over the last few hours, with time series functions, and need answers in seconds.

defect_images.needs: Data scientists train a defect model in PySpark on camera images, CSV exports from the line and Parquet files from a supplier.

shared_curated.needs: Data engineers build curated Delta tables with Spark. A group of analysts must query those tables with T-SQL from SSMS, read only: they never write to them.

analyst_loads.needs: A team that only writes T-SQL must load structured CSV files themselves with COPY INTO, then UPDATE and DELETE rows in those tables.
